goal: Thoroughly close the seven independently proven BlueStacks preparation blockers through authoritative research, an independently proved integrated plan, cohesive implementation, hostile review, and final validation without live host activity.
deliverables: Source-backed closure requirements for Windows identity, capture, input, cancellation, and offline semantic evidence
One integrated file-level implementation plan mapping every blocker to code, invariants, executable tests, and documentation
Independent pre-implementation proof that the plan fully addresses all seven blockers and prior attack evidence
Independent hostile review and final acceptance evidence for implementation, host safety, package, and no-live gates
nonGoals: Launching, compiling on Windows, deploying, probing, capturing from, or controlling BlueStacks or the Windows host
Installing SDKs or changing Linux, Windows, BlueStacks, user-global, or account configuration
Network services, ADB, credentials, game traffic inspection, publication, or Git mutation
Inventing BlueStacks process paths, titles, selectors, coordinates, templates, or NBA 2K27 UI mechanics
Accepting token-presence tests, documentation assertions, or passing repository tests as substitutes for adversarial behavioral evidence

workUnits.goal: Resolve exact authoritative native/API and testability requirements behind all seven final findings.
workUnits.deliverable: Cited closure matrix with facts, invariants, implementation implications, and offline evidence strategy.
nonGoals: No edits to the durable package

workUnits.goal: Design one coherent state, identity, pixel, preview, approval, input, cancellation, conformance, and documentation solution for all findings.
workUnits.deliverable: Exact dependency-ordered file/function/test plan with a seven-finding traceability matrix.

workUnits.goal: Independently prove before implementation that the plan closes every prior reproduction and has meaningful offline evidence for native semantics.
workUnits.deliverable: Blocking/nonblocking plan findings and executable pre-implementation gate matrix.

workUnits.goal: Implement the independently proved plan as one integrated change preserving all accepted offline behavior.
workUnits.deliverable: Closed implementation, generated/shared contracts, semantic conformance vectors, adversarial tests, and consistent documentation.

workUnits.goal: Attack the integrated change using every prior reproduction plus cross-boundary and mutation cases before final acceptance.
workUnits.deliverable: Findings-first focused security and behavioral review.

workUnits.goal: Independently verify complete package integration and all preparation/no-live gates after hostile review passes.
workUnits.deliverable: Final command-backed gate matrix and activation blockers.

acceptanceGates.criterion: Authoritative evidence resolves required Windows identity, capture pixels/provenance, input binding, cancellation, and meaningful offline conformance semantics.
acceptanceGates.evidenceCommand: Inspect citations and claim-to-invariant matrix in the researcher trace.

acceptanceGates.criterion: One dependency-ordered plan maps all seven findings and every prior reproduction to exact files, invariants, tests, and docs.
acceptanceGates.evidenceCommand: Inspect planner trace and seven-finding traceability matrix.

acceptanceGates.criterion: An independent validator finds no missing contract, attack, cross-language evidence, or integration step before implementation.
acceptanceGates.evidenceCommand: Inspect plan-proof findings and executable gate matrix.

acceptanceGates.criterion: Launcher and companion validate exact expected hello, executable, protocol, session, process, window, geometry, and correlation identity without self-asserted trust.
acceptanceGates.evidenceCommand: Run identity mutation and transcript adversarial tests.

acceptanceGates.criterion: Fresh bounded pixel bytes and provenance feed deterministic calibrated recognition whose sealed preview derives selector and expected states without caller synthesis.
acceptanceGates.evidenceCommand: Run pixel mutation, stale/replay/provenance, calibration/template, and preview derivation tests.

acceptanceGates.criterion: Input is fully bound to capture, preview, approval, canary, identity, geometry, budgets, and cancellation with immediate fail-closed rechecks.
acceptanceGates.evidenceCommand: Run binding omission/mutation, focus/geometry/canary drift, budget, partial input, abort, EOF, and cancellation tests.

acceptanceGates.criterion: Shared generated contracts and executable semantic vectors prove Node, fake companion, and C# state/operation agreement beyond token presence, with compiler skip honestly bounded.
acceptanceGates.evidenceCommand: Run generators, stale-output checks, semantic vectors, mutation tests, and offline compile when available.

acceptanceGates.criterion: Protocol and operator documentation exactly match generated contracts and native behavior without live-readiness overclaim.
acceptanceGates.evidenceCommand: Run documentation contract/link/example checks and inspect staged activation statements.

acceptanceGates.criterion: Independent hostile review reproduces all prior attacks and finds no gate-linked defect.
acceptanceGates.evidenceCommand: Run focused validator attack suite and inspect findings-first trace.

acceptanceGates.criterion: All baseline and closure behavior passes together with no schema, CLI, package, or safety regression.
acceptanceGates.evidenceCommand: Run the complete tests, CLI matrices, source/package scans, and integration vectors.

acceptanceGates.criterion: Package remains private, dependency-free, source-only, and excludes credentials, local config, evidence, binaries, build output, tests, and lifecycle scripts.
acceptanceGates.evidenceCommand: Run npm ls --all --json and npm pack --dry-run --json and inspect every entry.

acceptanceGates.criterion: No Windows/BlueStacks/native process, network, ADB, capture, input, account, Git, publication, or global mutation occurs or becomes reachable by default/public CLI.
acceptanceGates.evidenceCommand: Run process/network sentinels, authority scans, and public reachability attacks.
